name: Jump 'n' Shoot
author: Matheus Foltran Consonni
description: A fast action platformer: dodge obstacles, take out enemies and survive as long as you can; destroying enemies or their shots adds points. X to jump, Z to shoot.

descriptions.en: A fast action platformer: dodge obstacles, take out enemies and survive as long as you can; destroying enemies or their shots adds points. X to jump, Z to shoot.
descriptions.it: Un platform d'azione frenetico: schiva gli ostacoli, elimina i nemici e resisti il più a lungo possibile; colpire nemici e proiettili dà punti. X per saltare, Z per sparare.
